title: Your Bank Might Charge You $35 For a $4 Coffee

scenes.heading: Wait...
lines: Your bank might charge you thirty five dollars for a four dollar coffee.

scenes.heading: How?
lines: If your account is a little short, many banks still approve the payment.

scenes.heading: The fee
lines: And then they hit you with an overdraft fee. Often around thirty five dollars.

scenes.heading: Again. And again.
lines: Three small purchases on a bad day? That can be over a hundred dollars in fees.

scenes.heading: The fix #1
lines: Here's the move. Call your bank or open the app, and turn off overdraft coverage for debit card purchases.

scenes.heading: What happens?
lines: Now if you're short, the card just gets declined. Awkward for a second, but free.

scenes.heading: The fix #2
lines: Then set a low balance alert, so your phone warns you before it happens.

scenes.heading: Two minutes
lines: Two minutes today can save you hundreds this year.

scenes.heading: Your turn
lines: Do it right now. And follow for one simple money move every day!
